name: Putney Heath Gorse Flowers
description: Gorse flowers are abundant on Putney Heath and flower almost year-round. The coconut-scented blooms can be used in salads, teas and syrups.

name: Battersea Park Elderflower & Berries

description: Elder bushes grow along the wilder fringes of Battersea Park. Harvest flowers for cordial in early summer and berries in early autumn.
